alt: 學生從容介紹雨水花園模型，面帶微笑並以輕鬆手勢說明，同學安靜聆聽。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 侃侃而談 describes speaking calmly, confidently and at ease. A middle-school student stands beside a small model of a rain garden during a school presentation, speaking with an easy relaxed smile and one gentle open-hand gesture; classmates sit comfortably listening with interest, one nodding. The speaker is neither shouting nor gesturing wildly, and the audience looks engaged rather than confused. Show calm, unhurried composure and coherent explanation without any speech text. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms/legs per visible person, natural seated postures and hand gestures. Safe stable model and classroom furniture. No readable writing.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks, brands or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary classroom. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor, colored-pencil grain/hatching on warm ivory textured paper; restrained natural colors, no glossy digital style or 3D.
